# Introduction {.unnumbered}

[🇩🇪 Auf Deutsch lesen](../de/index.html){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-secondary style="float:right"}

**gdrive-fuse** mounts a Google Drive account as a local filesystem on Linux.
The kernel communicates through the FUSE3 interface — no root privileges required.

The project is a multi-language monorepo with two complete, functionally
equivalent implementations:

| Client | Language | Standard | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clients/cpp` | C++20 | C++20 | Reference implementation |
| `clients/rust` | Rust 2021 | Edition 2021 | Production-ready, LRU cache |

Both clients implement:

- Google Drive REST API v3 (list, download, upload, delete)
- OAuth2 Authorization Code Flow with automatic token refresh
- ETag-based 3-state directory cache (`FRESH → STALE → INVALID`)
- File content cache with size limits
- Fine-grained concurrency locking
- Background change-watcher (Drive Changes API)

## Project Structure

```
gdrive-fuse/
├── clients/
│   ├── cpp/          # C++20 implementation (CMake)
│   └── rust/         # Rust implementation (Cargo)
├── benchmarks/
│   └── run.sh        # Performance comparison (hyperfine)
├── docs/
│   ├── BUILD.md      # Build guide
│   └── manual/       # This manual (Quarto)
└── Makefile          # Top-level, delegates to clients
```

## Requirements at a Glance

- Linux with FUSE3 (`libfuse3 ≥ 3.10`)
- Google Cloud OAuth2 credentials (`credentials.json`)
- Membership in the `fuse` group (or `user_allow_other` in `/etc/fuse.conf`)

Detailed installation instructions are in the [Usage](usage.html#sec-en-usage-install) chapter.
